@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Iceland&display=swap');
@import "tailwindcss";

* {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  -moz-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
}

/* =========================================
   GLOBALS & SCROLLBAR HIDING
   ========================================= */
html,
body,
#root,
.App {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: auto !important;
  overflow-y: auto !important; /* Enables smooth mouse scrolling */
  -ms-overflow-style: none;    /* Hides scrollbar in IE and Edge */
  scrollbar-width: none;       /* Hides scrollbar in Firefox */
}

/* Hides scrollbar in Chrome, Safari and Opera */
html::-webkit-scrollbar,
body::-webkit-scrollbar,
#root::-webkit-scrollbar,
.App::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

html,
body,
#root {
  font-family: 'Iceland', cursive;
}

body {
  background: #0a0a0c;
}

.App {
  position: relative;
  background: #0a0a0c;
  color: #fff;
  font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  overflow-y: auto !important;
}

/* =========================================
   LOADER & BACKGROUND
   ========================================= */
.App-Loader {
  position: fixed;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  z-index: 9999;
  display: block;
  width: auto;
  height: auto;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: visible;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease, visibility 0.5s ease;
}

.App-Loader > * {
  display: block;
  width: auto;
  height: auto;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.App-Loader * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
}

.App-Loader svg text,
.App-Loader svg tspan {
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
}

.App-Loader.loaded {
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.App-Background {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #0a0a0c;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.6s ease, visibility 0.6s ease;
}

.App-Background canvas,
.App-Background img,
.App-Background svg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.App-Loader.loaded ~ .App-Background {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
}

/* =========================================
   LAYOUT CONTENT
   ========================================= */
.Content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: visible;
  background: transparent;
}

.App-content {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  color: inherit;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(6px);
  transition: opacity 0.55s ease 0.2s, transform 0.55s ease 0.2s;
}

.App-Loader.loaded ~ .Content .App-content {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.Intro-content {
  position: absolute;
  top: 55px;
  left: 32px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  width: max-content;
  max-width: calc(100% - 64px);
  gap: 20px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  color: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

.Intro-bottom-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 300px 560px 480px;
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: clamp(100px, 6vw, 90px);
  width: max-content;
  margin-top: 50px;
}

/* 1. Sidebar */
.Intro-NavBar {
  width: 300px;
  margin: 0;
  z-index: 4;
}

.Intro-NavBar ul,
.Intro-NavBar li,
.Intro-NavBar span,
.Intro-NavBar nav {
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

.line-sidebar__index {
  margin-right: 1.2rem !important;
  font-size: 18px !important;
}

/* 2. Terminal */
.Intro-content .Intro-terminal {
  position: relative !important;
  width: 580px;
  margin: 0 !important;
  overflow: visible;
  pointer-events: auto;
  z-index: 3;
}

.Intro-content .Intro-terminal > div {
  display: block;
  transform: none;
}

/* 3. 3D Logo */
.Intro-content .Intro-logo-block {
  position: relative;
  width: 480px;
  height: 480px;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: visible;
  pointer-events: auto;
  z-index: 2;
}

.Intro-logo-block > * {
  display: block;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  overflow: visible;
}

.Intro-logo-block canvas,
.Intro-logo-block svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  overflow: visible;
}

/* =========================================
   TYPOGRAPHY & GLOBAL RESETS
   ========================================= */
.text-type {
  display: inline-block;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  color: #fff;
  font-family: 'Iceland', cursive;
  font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5.6vw, 3.6rem);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

.text-type__content {
  display: inline;
  color: inherit;
  background: transparent !important;
}

.text-type__cursor {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-left: 2px;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 500;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

.text-type__cursor--hidden {
  display: none;
}

.Intro-about {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  min-height: 1.6em;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  color: inherit;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

.Intro-about__prefix {
  display: inline-block;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  color: #fff;
  font-family: 'Iceland', cursive;
  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3.6vw, 2.2rem);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

.rotating-tag {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: baseline;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  color: #fff;
  font-family: 'Iceland', cursive;
  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3.6vw, 2.2rem);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-align: left;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

.rotating-tag .text-rotate-element {
  display: inline-block;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

.rotating-tag .text-rotate-space {
  white-space: pre;
}

.rotating-tag-word {
  overflow: hidden;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

.App-content h1,
.App-content h2,
.App-content h3,
.App-content h4,
.App-content h5,
.App-content h6,
.App-content p,
.App-content span:not(.shiny-text), 
.App-content a,
.App-content div {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  color: inherit;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

.App-content h2 {
  font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.8vw, 2.4rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}

.App-content p {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  color: #d6d6d8;
  font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 1.8vw, 1.05rem);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.App-content a {
  color: #fff;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.App-content a:hover {
  color: #d6d6d8;
}

:focus,
:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: none;
}

/* =========================================
   SHINY TEXT FIXES
   ========================================= */
.App-content span.shiny-text {
  display: inline-block !important;
  font-family: 'Iceland', cursive !important;
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 3rem) !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-align: center;
  
  /* Protects descenders like 'g' from clipping */
  padding-bottom: 0.15em !important; 
  line-height: 1.2 !important; 
  
  background-image: linear-gradient(120deg, #ffffff 35%, #498995 50%, #ffffff 65%) !important;
  background-size: 200% auto !important;
  -webkit-background-clip: text !important;
  background-clip: text !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent !important;
  color: transparent !important;
  animation: shine 3s linear infinite !important;
  
  margin: 0;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

@keyframes shine {
  0% { background-position: 200% center; }
  100% { background-position: -200% center; }
}

.Intro-end {
  align-self: center; 
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 10px; 
  padding-bottom: 20px; 
  position: relative;
  z-index: 100;
}

.Intro-end,
.Intro-end *,
.shiny-text {
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* =========================================
   TERMINAL STYLES
   ========================================= */
.Intro-terminal .terminal-container {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  width: 580px !important;
  max-width: 580px !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  color: #d6deeb !important;
  font-family: "JetBrains Mono", "Fira Code", "Courier New", monospace !important;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #141414 0%, #0a0a0a 100%) !important;
  background-clip: padding-box !important;
  border: 1px solid #262626 !important;
  border-radius: 14px !important;
  box-shadow:
    0 36px 90px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) inset,
    0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) inset !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .title-bar {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 16px 20px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1f1f1f 0%, #141414 100%) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #262626 !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .traffic-lights {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .dot {
  display: inline-block !important;
  width: 16px !important;
  height: 16px !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22),
    0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
}

.App-content .Intro-terminal .dot-red {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #ff8585, #ef4444 70%, #991b1b) !important;
}

.App-content .Intro-terminal .dot-yellow {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #fde68a, #eab308 70%, #854d0e) !important;
}

.App-content .Intro-terminal .dot-green {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #86efac, #22c55e 70%, #166534) !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .terminal-title {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  color: #cbd5e1 !important;
  font-family: "JetBrains Mono", "Fira Code", "Courier New", monospace !important;
  font-size: 17px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .terminal-body {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 26px 26px 30px !important;
  color: #d6deeb !important;
  font-size: 21px !important;
  line-height: 1.6 !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .line {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  align-items: baseline !important;
  margin-bottom: 12px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  color: #d6deeb !important;
  font-family: "JetBrains Mono", "Fira Code", "Courier New", monospace !important;
  font-size: 21px !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .prompt {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  color: #e5e5e5 !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .sep {
  margin: 0 4px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  color: #6b7280 !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .path {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  color: #e5e5e5 !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .dollar {
  margin: 0 8px 0 6px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  color: #a3a3a3 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .cmd {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  color: #d6deeb !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .caret {
  display: inline-block !important;
  width: 9px !important;
  height: 18px !important;
  margin-left: 8px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  vertical-align: -3px !important;
  background: #ffffff !important;
  border-radius: 1px !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  animation: blink 1s steps(2, end) infinite !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .out {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: baseline !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  margin-bottom: 12px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  color: #a3a3a3 !important;
  font-family: "JetBrains Mono", "Fira Code", "Courier New", monospace !important;
  font-size: 14.5px !important;
  line-height: 1.55 !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .bullet {
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  width: 14px !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  color: #6b7280 !important;
  text-align: center !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .green-line {
  margin-bottom: 12px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .line-1 {
  animation: green-color 3s infinite !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .line-2 {
  animation: green-color 3.5s infinite !important;
}

.Intro-terminal .line-3 {
  animation: green-color 2s infinite !important;
}

@keyframes green-color {
  0% { color: #525252; }
  50% { color: #a3a3a3; }
  100% { color: #525252; }
}

@keyframes blink {
  0%, 50% { opacity: 1; }
  50.01%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
}

/* =========================================
   MOBILE LAYOUT
   ========================================= */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .Intro-content {
    top: 64px;
    left: 16px;
    width: calc(100% - 32px);
    max-width: calc(100% - 32px);
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .text-type {
    font-size: 2.2rem;
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .App-content h2 {
    font-size: 1.6rem;
  }

  .Intro-bottom-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    width: 100%;
    gap: 32px;
    margin-top: 32px;
  }

  .Intro-NavBar {
    width: auto;
  }

  .Intro-content .Intro-terminal {
    width: min(540px, calc(100vw - 32px));
    margin: 0 auto !important; /* Centers the wrapper using auto margins */
    align-self: center; /* Overrides the parent's flex-start to force centering */
  }

  .Intro-terminal .terminal-container {
    width: 100% !important; /* Allows the terminal to shrink on smaller phones */
    max-width: 540px !important; /* Caps the maximum width */
  }

  .Intro-content .Intro-logo-block {
    width: min(280px, calc(100vw - 32px));
    height: min(280px, calc(100vw - 32px));
    margin: 40px auto !important; /* Centers it horizontally and balances vertical space */
    align-self: center; /* Forces it to the middle of the flex column */
    border: none !important; /* Forces the stray line to disappear */
    outline: none !important; 
  }

  .Intro-end {
    margin-top: 40px;
    padding-bottom: 20px;
  }
}









App.jsx:
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import "./App.css";
import Silk from "./components/Silk";
import TextType from "./components/TextType";
import RotatingText from "./components/RotatingText";
import Terminal from "./components/Terminal";
import StrokeText from "./components/StrokeText";
import LineSidebar from "./components/LineSidebar";
import ShinyText from "./components/ShinyText";
import { SVG3D } from "3dsvg";


function App() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const mySvg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="192" height="192" viewBox="0 0 192 192"><path d="M24,0L36,0L48,0L60,0L72,0L84,0L96,0L108,0L120,0L132,0L132,12L120,12L108,12L96,12L84,12L72,12L60,12L48,12L36,12L36,24L36,36L36,48L36,60L36,72L48,72L60,72L72,72L84,72L96,72L108,72L120,72L120,84L120,96L120,108L120,120L120,132L120,144L120,156L108,156L96,156L84,156L72,156L60,156L48,156L36,156L24,156L12,156L12,144L24,144L36,144L36,132L36,120L36,108L36,96L48,96L60,96L72,96L72,108L72,120L72,132L72,144L84,144L84,132L84,120L96,120L96,132L96,144L108,144L108,132L108,120L108,108L108,96L108,84L96,84L84,84L72,84L60,84L48,84L36,84L24,84L24,72L24,60L24,48L24,36L24,24L24,12L24,0Z M48,24L60,24L60,36L72,36L72,24L84,24L84,36L72,36L72,48L60,48L60,60L48,60L48,48L48,36L48,24Z M96,24L108,24L120,24L120,36L108,36L108,48L108,60L96,60L96,48L96,36L96,24Z M72,48L84,48L84,60L72,60L72,48Z M120,48L132,48L132,60L120,60L120,48Z M84,96L96,96L96,108L84,108L84,96Z M48,108L60,108L60,120L48,120L48,108Z M48,132L60,132L60,144L48,144L48,132Z" fill="black" fill-rule="evenodd"/></svg>`;

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setLoading(false);
    }, 1300); 

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  return (
    <section className="App">
      <div className={`App-Loader ${loading ? "" : "loaded"}`}>
        <StrokeText/>
      </div>
      <div className="App-Background">
        <Silk
          speed={8.5}
          scale={0.9}
          color="#1c1c1e"
          noiseIntensity={1.2}
          rotation={0.45}
        />
      </div>
      <section className="Content">
        <div className="App-content">
          <div className = "Intro-content">
            <TextType
              text={["> init. Srikar Yerraguntla : Software Engineer","Welcome to my corner of the internet.","I build things that think"]}
              typingSpeed={45}
              pauseDuration={2000}
              showCursor={true}
              cursorCharacter="^"
              deletingSpeed={50}
              variableSpeedEnabled={false}
              variableSpeedMin={60}
              variableSpeedMax={120}
              cursorBlinkDuration={0.5}
            />
            <div className="Intro-about">
              <span className="Intro-about__prefix">I am a</span>
              <RotatingText
                texts={['Machine Learning Engineer','Gen AI Specialist','Backend Developer','Problem Solver']}
                mainClassName="rotating-tag"
                staggerFrom="last"
                initial={{ y: "100%" }}
                animate={{ y: 0 }}
                exit={{ y: "-120%" }}
                staggerDuration={0.05}
                splitLevelClassName="rotating-tag-word"
                transition={{ type: "spring", damping: 30, stiffness: 400 }}
                rotationInterval={3500}
                splitBy="words"
                auto = {true}
                loop = {true}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="Intro-bottom-row">
              <div className="Intro-NavBar">
                <LineSidebar
                  items={['Overview', 'Components', 'Animations', 'Backgrounds', 'Showcase','abcd','efdgh']}
                  accentColor="#4cc0d3"
                  textColor="#c4c4c4"
                  markerColor="#6c6c6c"
                  showIndex ={false}
                  showMarker ={true}
                  proximityRadius={100}
                  maxShift={30}
                  falloff="smooth"
                  markerLength={60}
                  markerGap={0}
                  tickScale={0.5}
                  scaleTick ={true}
                  itemGap={20}
                  fontSize={1.15}
                  smoothing={100}
                  defaultActive={0}
                  onItemClick={(index, label) => console.log(index, label)}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="Intro-terminal">
                <Terminal/>
              </div>
              <div className="Intro-logo-block">
                <SVG3D
                  svg={mySvg}
                  depth={1.1}
                  smoothness={0.4}
                  color="#3b82f6"
                  texture="data:image/png;base64,"
                  animate="swing"
                  animateSpeed={1.3}
                  zoom={5.8}
                  cursorOrbit
                  orbitStrength={0.4}
                  resetOnIdle={true}
                  resetDelay={2.5}
                  lightIntensity={1.3}
                  shadow={false}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="Intro-end">
              <ShinyText
                text="Welcome, let's see what we can build together"
                speed={0.85}
                delay={0.65}
                color="#ffffff"
                shineColor="#000000"
                spread={120}
                direction="left"
                yoyo={false}
                pauseOnHover={false}
                disabled={false}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </section>
  );
}
export default App;
